Current support path

The old external support link has been retired so nobody gets sent to a dead page. For now, join the support waitlist below and I will reopen giving with a working path.

Need to reach me now about receipts, support, or the site itself? Use the contact form or support email.

What your gift supports

Servers, careful security work, and time to tend the KJV verse, prayer wall, battle plans, and family tools. The site stays free to use; this is a door for people who want to help carry the cost.

Recent care also kept the Bible Tool readable in every appearance—night, daylight, and dawn parchment—so search, chips, and verse cards do not fight the colors you chose.

Quiet spring notes: steadier Sunday backgrounds in the small seasonal touches, cleaner console compatibility for analytics under our Trusted Types policy, and a gentle post-Easter plan for tired Mondays after Holy Week.

  • Cloudflare hosting and CDN so the site stays fast, quiet, and reachable on hard days.
  • KJV upkeep, search index refreshes, and offline reliability so verses still load when service is weak.
  • New Bible Studies, Battle Plans, and family printables reviewed by hand instead of auto-generated filler.

See where support goes (plain-language transparency page).

Three ways to help right now

Pray

Pray the site stays useful, clean, and faithful for people who open it in pain, fear, grief, or exhaustion.

Share

If the site helped you, share the homepage, a daily verse, or a Battle Plan with one person.

Give later, with clarity

When support checkout reopens, it will return here first so you can see the current path before leaving the site.
